description:
Creates, lists, shows and deletes person files. People are link targets for note attendees and task assignees; they are never threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list people (open only by default)
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CAT — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Flags:
  list:
    QUERY   optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity
    --all   include closed people
    --json  JSON output
  show:
    --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME  required. Full name; becomes the filename. Must not contain '/' or start with '.'.
    --category   required. One of: professional, personal, voluntary
  delete:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm the delete

Args:
  PERSON  full name, matching the filename without .md

Examples:
  ["list", "jane"]
  ["show", "Jane Doe"]
  ["new", "--name", "Jane Doe", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  Create a person before assigning tasks to them or linking them as a note attendee.
  delete is permanent. Without -y it refuses and exits 1.
  Exit code 1 also means: the person already exists, the person is not found, or the name is empty or invalid.
